Product Catalog Browser

Browse the seasonal product lineup grouped by category. Shoppers can filter the catalog by season, price tier, or availability, and the grid view updates instantly as filters are applied.

Each catalog entry links out to a dedicated product page with sizing charts, fabric composition, and shopper photos. The catalog browser paginates results so that large seasonal collections load quickly on slower connections.

Merchandising staff can reorder categories within the catalog browser to promote new seasonal arrivals at the top of the grid without editing individual product records.
